text:
zoe: Huge shoutout to @rafa and @kyle for swooping in last night when alerts went wild and saving the demo — also brought tacos at 2:03am :taco: :sparkles

rafa: those tacos were the real MVPs. found a stray `if SKIP_HEALTH` in the deploy script that skipped rollout checks. fixed `scripts/deploy.sh` line 27 and redeployed.

kyle: rolled back the feature-flagged change, ran smoke, all green. quick check I ran: ```curl -sS https://prod.health/ok | grep OK``` -> OK

infra-bot: Incident created: INC-4523 by rafa. Severity: sev2. Pager: infra-oncall.

emma: big thanks to @zoe for coordinating peoples and the midnight playlist — morale boost for sure :headphones: :raised_hands:

zoe: credit to @maria for the playlist, i just volunteered as tribute. leftover tacos in the 2nd-floor kitchen if anyone wants them. tag me and i'll point you to the box. :yum:

rafa: tiny ops note: updated alert dedupe rules to suppress duplicate k8s/events flaps for 10m. ping me if anything odd shows up.

kyle: adding this to the kudos board and the retro under "what saved the demo": "Tacos, tunes, and triage" :memo: :trophy:

ops-bot: Oncall update: added kyle to infra-oncall until 2025-06-01T07:00Z (auto-notify: oncall-sched)

emma: sending the gif because tacos + late triage = iconic: https://giphy.com/gifs/taco-party-3oEduQAsYcJKQH2XsI

zoe: agreed. massive thanks everyone, truly team effort <3 :sparkling_heart:
